package org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.opmodes;

import com.pedropathing.api.Paths;
import com.pedropathing.api.PoseFactory;
import com.pedropathing.math.Pose;
import com.pedropathing.paths.Path;

import org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.config.Field;
import org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.config.MatchState;
import org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.config.Tuned;
import org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.opmodes.AutoRunner.During;
import org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.opmodes.AutoRunner.End;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

// Generated by refract-suite ftc-construct.
//
// SAMPLE AUTO. It is not a match auto and its waypoints are not real field positions. It is the reference route
// for this robot: the one place that shows every action AutoRunner has and how a route is written, for the team
// and for AutoTool / PedroAI to learn the code style from. Real match autos are separate classes (AutoTool
// writes them, like Blue_Near_9) and never edit this file.
//
// KEEP IT CURRENT. After every CAD, wiring or tuning step that changes what an auto can do (docs/BIOBUZZ_PLAN.md
// "Sample auto"), update this file, SampleAutoBlue/Red, the table below and the sim test test_auto_park.py in the
// same change. A stale sample teaches the wrong code.
//
// Drawn on the BLUE side. Red is the 180-degree rotation of it (MatchState.poseFactory()); never tick the
// visualizer's mirror option, and put a pose through redTrim(...) if red needs a field correction.
//
// A leg is a path + what happens while driving it (During) + what happens at its end (End) + options.
// The route (legs() at the bottom) uses every one of them:
//   1 NONE   -> SHOOT  drive to the shot pose, stop, fire when still + aimed + both flywheels at speed
//   2 INTAKE -> WAIT   drive with the intake running, then hold still waitFor(0.5) s, intake still on
//   3 INTAKE -> SHOOT  keep collecting on the way back, fire at the end; shotTimeout(3) skips a shot not
//                      ready in 3 s
//   4 RAMP   -> NONE   drive with the ramp out and the intake running (POLLEN from a FLOWER bottom, G418);
//                      carryIntake keeps the intake on a moment into the next leg
//   5 NONE   -> PARK   a leg built from a target pose (straight from wherever the robot ended: the RAMP leg ends
//                      pressed into a FLOWER, so its planned end is not where it stopped), then hold
// timeout() ends the drive of a leg that presses into something. The older form new Leg(path, Action.SHOOT)
// still compiles: each Action is one During/End pair.
// Every waypoint lies on the line from the blueStart to the bluePark pose, so the sample cannot leave the field.
//
// What an auto uses on this robot, and where it comes from. Update the right column when a step changes it.
//   hardware map (DeviceNames, must equal the Robot Controller configuration; checked in INIT)
//     lf lb rf rb  drive motors            pp   Pinpoint         intake  intake motor
//     lt           turret motor (both)     fs bs  flywheels (front NECTAR, back POLLEN)
//     fpanel bpanel hood servos            fg bg  feed gates      ramp   ramp servo     yz  turret index (optional)
//   Tuned values the route reads (config/Tuned, generated from team-config.yaml)
//     blueStartX/Y/Heading, blueParkX/Y/Heading   start and park              H-2, replaced by the real route
//     centerTo*  (Field.cornerPose, start against the wall)                   CAD
//     front/backPivotX/Y, red*CellX/Y, front/backYawTrimDeg   aim target     H-1, programs 3, 8, 9
//     yaw*  (Yaw: ticks per degree, kP, friction, limits)                     program 3
//     front/back flywheel gains, hood range, shot table, feed power          programs 7, 8, 9
//     front/backGateClosed/Open, gateTravelS, rampStowed/Deployed             program 4 (E-8)
//     Pedro follower and Pinpoint constants (pedro/Constants)                 program 5, F-1, F-2
//   rules the route has to respect: R102/G403 nothing moves in INIT or between AUTO and TELEOP, G402 stay on our
//   side of the field in AUTO, G407 at most 4 elements held (the mechanism limits it), G418 POLLEN only from the
//   bottom of a FLOWER.
//   not in AutoRunner yet (add to it, and to this sample, when a real auto or the CAD needs it): shooting from one
//   launcher only and counting elements (both would be options on an End.SHOOT leg), reading a sensor to end a
//   leg early.
public class SampleAutoPaths {
    private final PoseFactory poseFactory = MatchState.poseFactory();

    private final Pose start = along(0);
    private final Pose shoot = along(0.25);
    private final Pose intakeEnd = along(0.55);
    private final Pose rampEnd = along(0.8);
    private final Pose park = along(1);

    public static boolean ready() {
        return Tuned.isSet(Tuned.blueStartX, Tuned.blueStartY, Tuned.blueStartHeading,
                Tuned.blueParkX, Tuned.blueParkY, Tuned.blueParkHeading);
    }

    // The pose a fraction t of the way from the start pose to the park pose (heading the short way round).
    private Pose along(double t) {
        double turn = Field.wrapDeg(Tuned.blueParkHeading - Tuned.blueStartHeading);
        return redTrim(poseFactory.of(
                Tuned.blueStartX + t * (Tuned.blueParkX - Tuned.blueStartX),
                Tuned.blueStartY + t * (Tuned.blueParkY - Tuned.blueStartY),
                Tuned.blueStartHeading + t * turn), 0, 0, 0);
    }

    // Red-only field correction (in, deg) added after the 180-degree rotation, for differences between the
    // two halves of a real field found in practice. DECODE 19859 needed 1-3 in on its close auto because
    // its red side was a mirror (robot turns flipped); a rotation keeps the robot's motion identical, so
    // expect these to stay near 0. Blue ignores them.
    private static Pose redTrim(Pose pose, double dx, double dy, double dHeadingDeg) {
        if (MatchState.alliance != MatchState.Alliance.RED) return pose;
        return new Pose(pose.x() + dx, pose.y() + dy, pose.heading() + Math.toRadians(dHeadingDeg));
    }

    public Pose start() {
        return start;
    }

    private static Path line(Pose from, Pose to) {
        return Paths.line(from, to).linear(from, to);
    }

    public List<AutoRunner.Leg> legs() {
        return Arrays.asList(
                new AutoRunner.Leg(line(start, shoot), During.NONE, End.SHOOT),
                new AutoRunner.Leg(line(shoot, intakeEnd), During.INTAKE, End.WAIT).timeout(4).waitFor(0.5),
                new AutoRunner.Leg(line(intakeEnd, shoot), During.INTAKE, End.SHOOT).shotTimeout(3),
                new AutoRunner.Leg(line(shoot, rampEnd), During.RAMP, End.NONE).timeout(4).carryIntake(0.5),
                new AutoRunner.Leg(park, During.NONE, End.PARK));
    }
}
